questions.question: A and B invested ₹10,000 and ₹15,000 respectively. If the business made a profit of ₹12,000, what is A's share?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

A's investment = ₹10,000

B's investment = ₹15,000

Total profit = ₹12,000

**Formula Used:**

A's share = (A's investment ÷ Total investment) × Total profit

Total investment = A's investment + B's investment

**Calculation:**

⇒ Total investment = ₹10,000 + ₹15,000

⇒ Total investment = ₹25,000

⇒ A's share = (₹10,000 ÷ ₹25,000) × ₹12,000

⇒ A's share = (0.4) × ₹12,000

⇒ A's share = ₹4,800

**∴ The correct answer is ₹4,800.**

questions.question: The average of 6 numbers is 18. If two numbers 14 and 22 are removed, what is the new average of the remaining numbers?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Average of 6 numbers = 18

Numbers removed = 14 and 22

**Formula Used:**

Total sum = Average × Number of values

New average = (New total sum) ÷ (New number of values)

**Calculation:**

⇒ Total sum of 6 numbers = 18 × 6

⇒ Total sum = 108

⇒ Sum of remaining numbers = Total sum − (Sum of removed numbers)

⇒ Sum of remaining numbers = 108 − (14 + 22)

⇒ Sum of remaining numbers = 108 − 36

⇒ Sum of remaining numbers = 72

⇒ New average = 72 ÷ 4

⇒ New average = 18

**∴ The correct answer is 18.**

questions.question: If A's income is 20% more than B's and B earns Rs. 50,000, what percent less is B's income than A's?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

B's income = 50000

A's income is 20% more than B

**Formula Used:**

Percentage increase = (Increase ÷ Original) × 100

Percentage decrease = (Difference ÷ Original value) × 100

**Calculation:**

⇒ Increase in A's income = 20% of 50000

⇒ Increase = (20 ÷ 100) × 50000 = 10000

⇒ A's income = 50000 + 10000 = 60000

⇒ Difference = 60000 − 50000 = 10000

⇒ Percentage less = (10000 ÷ 60000) × 100

⇒ = 16.66%

**∴ The correct answer is 16.66%.**

questions.question: A discount of 5% is given on an article priced at Rs. 2,000. Find the selling price.
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Original price = Rs. 2,000

Discount = 5%

**Formula Used:**

Discount amount = (Discount % × Original price) ÷ 100

Selling price = Original price - Discount amount

**Calculation:**

⇒ Discount amount = (5 × 2,000) ÷ 100

⇒ Discount amount = 10,000 ÷ 100

⇒ Discount amount = Rs. 100

⇒ Selling price = 2,000 - 100

⇒ Selling price = Rs. 1,900

**∴ The correct answer is Rs. 1,900.**

questions.question: A rhombus-shaped support structure has sides 10 cm and one diagonal 16 cm. What is the other diagonal?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Side of rhombus = 10 cm

One diagonal = 16 cm

**Formula Used:**

(d₁ ÷ 2)² + (d₂ ÷ 2)² = side²

**Calculation:**

⇒ (16 ÷ 2)² + (d₂ ÷ 2)² = 10²

⇒ 8² + (d₂ ÷ 2)² = 100

⇒ 64 + (d₂ ÷ 2)² = 100

⇒ (d₂ ÷ 2)² = 36

⇒ d₂ ÷ 2 = 6

⇒ d₂ = 12 cm

**∴ The correct answer is 12 cm.**

questions.question: A pyramid-shaped puzzle piece fits exactly into a square-based hole of depth 4 cm. If the base is 6 cm, what is the volume of the pyramid?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

**Base Area** of square = side² = 6 × 6 = 36 cm².

**Volume** of **pyramid** = (1/3) × **Base Area** × **Height**.

Volume = (1/3) × 36 × 4 = 12 × 4 = 48 cm³.

**∴ The correct answer is 48 cm³.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

**Side** of **square base** (a) = 6 cm

**Depth** or **Vertical Height** (h) = 4 cm

**Formula Used:**

**Volume** of **pyramid** = (1/3) × **Base Area** × **Height**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3683406a871fa6d6ecc42dd2ec8612034ad8326c2a3e1fefc257c29e104c7e8a.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ **Base Area** = a² = 6 × 6 = 36 cm²

⇒ **Volume** = (1/3) × 36 × 4

⇒ **Volume** = 12 × 4

⇒ **Volume** = 48 cm³

**∴ The correct answer is 48 cm³.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Volume Property

A **pyramid** has exactly one-third the **volume** of a **prism** with the same **base area** and **height**.

Slant Height (l)

The **slant height** of a **square pyramid** is calculated using the Pythagorean theorem: l = √(h² + (a/2)²).

Surface Area

**Total Surface Area** = Base Area + (1/2) × Perimeter × Slant Height.</p

questions.question: A conical flask is perfectly fitted inside a cylindrical container. Both have a base radius of 5 cm and height 12 cm. What is the ratio of the cone's volume to that of the cylinder?
questions.solution:

Radius = 5 cm

Height = 12 cm

**Formula Used:**

Volume of cylinder = π × r² × h

questions.question: The product of two rational numbers is always:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

First rational number = a ÷ b

Second rational number = c ÷ d

**Formula Used:**

Product of two rational numbers = (a ÷ b) × (c ÷ d)

**Calculation:**

⇒ Product = (a × c) ÷ (b × d)

⇒ a × c is an integer

⇒ b × d is a non-zero integer

⇒ Result is in the form of p ÷ q

**∴ The correct answer is Rational number.**

questions.question: An architect designs a modern building facade using triangular glass panels. Each triangle has angles in the ratio 2:3:7. What is the measure of the largest angle in the panel?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Total ratio parts = 2 + 3 + 7 = 12 parts.

Total sum of angles in a triangle = 180º.

12 parts = 180º → 1 part = 15º.

Largest angle corresponds to 7 parts.

Measure = 7 × 15º = 105º.

**∴ The correct answer is 105º.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Ratio of **angles** in the **triangular glass panels** = 2 : 3 : 7

**Formula Used:**

Sum of all internal angles of a **triangle** = 180º

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3ce11ca602b7b89286e38527d0f95d256900eb36a7e1e4d5c6f9335213127a5e.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Let the angles be 2x, 3x, and 7x.

⇒ 2x + 3x + 7x = 180º

⇒ 12x = 180º

⇒ x = 180º ÷ 12

⇒ x = 15º

⇒ Largest angle = 7x = 7 × 15º

⇒ Largest angle = 105º

**∴ The correct answer is 105º.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Angle Sum Property

The sum of all interior angles of any triangle is always 180º, regardless of its shape or size.

Obtuse-Angled Triangle

A triangle is classified as obtuse if one of its angles is greater than 90º. In this panel, 105º > 90º, so it is an obtuse triangle.

Ratio and Proportion in Geometry

To find individual components from a ratio a:b:c, multiply the total value by the fraction [part / (a+b+c)].</p

questions.question: An artist forms triangle ABC. She connects the midpoints of its sides to form triangle DEF inside it. What is the area of triangle DEF in relation to triangle ABC?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Triangle DEF is formed by joining midpoints of triangle ABC

**Formula Used:**

Area of medial triangle = (1 ÷ 4) × Area of original triangle

**Calculation:**

⇒ Each side of DEF = (1 ÷ 2) of corresponding side of ABC

⇒ Ratio of sides = 1 ÷ 2

⇒ Ratio of areas = (1 ÷ 2)²

⇒ Ratio of areas = 1 ÷ 4

**∴ The correct answer is 1 ÷ 4 of triangle ABC.**

A mixture containing 22% of ethanol is mixed with another mixture containing a% of ethanol in the ratio 6: 7. If the percentage of ethanol in the final mixture is 15%, find the value of a.
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

By **Alligation** method, the ratio of the differences is equal to the quantity ratio.

(Higher % − Mean %) : (Mean % − Lower %) = Ratio 2 : Ratio 1

(22 − 15) : (15 − a) = 7 : 6

Since 7 units = 7, then 15 − a = 6.

a = 15 − 6 = 9%.

**∴ The correct answer is 9%.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Ethanol concentration in Mixture 1 = 22%

Ethanol concentration in Mixture 2 = a%

Mixing ratio = 6 : 7

Resultant concentration = 15%

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e7cc8ba1e7dd813d111a1be2b6d813a9894ac1461f904aa0f3544b7bb942d217.png] 

**Formula Used:**

Weighted Average = (n₁c₁ + n₂c₂) ÷ (n₁ + n₂)

**Calculations:**

⇒ Total mixture units = 6 + 7 = 13

⇒ Total Ethanol = (6 × 22) + (7 × a)

⇒ 15 = (132 + 7a) ÷ 13

⇒ 15 × 13 = 132 + 7a

⇒ 195 = 132 + 7a

⇒ 7a = 195 − 132

⇒ 7a = 63

⇒ a = 63 ÷ 7

⇒ a = 9

**∴ The correct answer is 9%.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Alligation Rule

It is a shortcut to find the ratio in which two ingredients at given prices/percentages must be mixed to produce a mixture of a desired price/percentage.

Weighted Average Formula

For two groups with averages A₁ and A₂ and sizes n₁ and n₂, the combined average is (n₁A₁ + n₂A₂) ÷ (n₁ + n₂).

Mixing of Pure Liquids

When pure water is added to a solution, its ethanol (or solute) percentage is considered 0% for calculation purposes.</p

questions.question: A sum becomes ₹12100 in 2 years at 10% Compound Interest annually. Find the principal.
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Amount = 12100

Rate = 10%

Time = 2 years

**Formula Used:**

Amount = Principal × (1 + r/100)t

**Calculation:**

⇒ 12100 = P × (1 + 10/100)²

⇒ 12100 = P × (1.1)²

⇒ 12100 = P × 1.21

⇒ P = 12100 ÷ 1.21

⇒ P = 10000

**∴ The correct answer is 10000.**

questions.question: The LCM and HCF of two numbers are 84 and 21 respectively. If the ratio of the two numbers is 1:4, the larger number is:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

LCM = 84

HCF = 21

Ratio = 1 : 4

**Formula Used:**

Product of two numbers = LCM × HCF

**Calculation:**

⇒ Let numbers = x and 4x

⇒ Product = x × 4x = 4x²

⇒ 4x² = 84 × 21

⇒ 4x² = 1764

⇒ x² = 1764 ÷ 4 = 441

⇒ x = 21

⇒ Larger number = 4x = 84

**∴ The correct answer is 84.**

questions.question: A dog starts chasing a rabbit that is 200 meters away. The dog runs at 25 m/s, and the rabbit runs at 20 m/s. How far will the rabbit have run before the dog catches it?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Distance between dog and rabbit = 200 m

Speed of dog = 25 m/s

Speed of rabbit = 20 m/s

**Formula Used:**

Time taken for dog to catch rabbit = Distance ÷ Relative speed

Distance run by rabbit = Speed of rabbit × Time

**Calculation:**

⇒ Relative speed = Speed of dog − Speed of rabbit

⇒ Relative speed = 25 − 20

⇒ Relative speed = 5 m/s

⇒ Time taken for dog to catch rabbit = 200 ÷ 5

⇒ Time = 40 s

⇒ Distance run by rabbit = Speed of rabbit × Time

⇒ Distance run by rabbit = 20 × 40

⇒ Distance = 800 m

**∴ The correct answer is 800 m.**

questions.question: Two circles, one with a radius of 13 cm and the other with a radius of 5 cm, have their centers 20 cm apart. A direct common tangent is drawn between the two circles. What is the length of this tangent?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Radius of larger circle (R) = 13 cm

Radius of smaller circle (r) = 5 cm

Distance between centers (d) = 20 cm

**Formula used:**

Length of direct common tangent = √(d² − (R − r)²)

**Calculations:**

⇒ Length = √(20² − (13 − 5)²)

⇒ √(400 − 8²)

⇒ √(400 − 64)

⇒ √336

**∴ Length of direct common tangent = √336 cm**

questions.question: Sum of A and B is 300 percent more than the sum of C and D. C is 50 percent more than D. If A is 200 percent more than B and D = 200, then what is the value of A?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

A + B = 300% more than (C + D)

⇒ A + B = 4(C + D)

C = 50% more than D ⇒ C = 1.5D

A = 200% more than B ⇒ A = 3B

D = 200

**Formula used:**

Percentage relation and substitution

**Calculations:**

⇒ C = 1.5 × 200 = 300

⇒ C + D = 300 + 200 = 500

⇒ A + B = 4 × 500 = 2000

⇒ A = 3B

⇒ 3B + B = 2000

⇒ 4B = 2000

⇒ B = 500

⇒ A = 3 × 500 = 1500

**∴ A = 1500**

questions.question: A sum is being lent at 10 percent per annum compound interest (compounding annually). What is the ratio of amount at the end of first year to the amount at the end of second year?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Rate of interest = 10% per annum

Compounding = Annually

**Formula Used:**

Amount at the end of n years = Principal × (1 + Rate/100)ⁿ

**Calculation:**

⇒ Let Principal = P

⇒ Amount at the end of the first year = P × (1 + 10/100)

⇒ Amount at the end of the first year = P × 1.1

⇒ Amount at the end of the second year = P × (1 + 10/100)²

⇒ Amount at the end of the second year = P × 1.1 × 1.1

⇒ Amount at the end of the second year = P × 1.21

⇒ Ratio of amount at the end of the first year to the amount at the end of the second year = (P × 1.1) : (P × 1.21)

⇒ Ratio = 1.1 : 1.21

⇒ Ratio = 10 : 11

**∴ The correct answer is 10:11.**

questions.question: Simple interest on a sum for 6 years is equal to 40 percent of the principal. In how many years interest will be equal to the principal?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Simple Interest (SI) for 6 years = 40% of Principal (P)

Time (T) = 6 years

SI = P × R × T ÷ 100

**Formula Used:**

SI = P × R × T ÷ 100

Time when SI = P: T = 100 ÷ R

**Calculation:**

⇒ 40% of P = P × R × 6 ÷ 100

⇒ 40 = R × 6

⇒ R = 40 ÷ 6

⇒ R = 6.67 (approximately)

Let time when SI = P be T years:

⇒ P = P × R × T ÷ 100

⇒ 100 = R × T

⇒ T = 100 ÷ R

⇒ T = 100 ÷ 6.67

⇒ T = 15 (approximately)

**∴ The correct answer is 15 years.**

questions.question: The value of discount given on an article is (2/17) of the marked price. What is the ratio of the value of discount to the selling price?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Discount = (2/17) of Marked Price

Marked Price = 17

**Formula Used:**

Ratio of Discount to Selling Price = Discount ÷ Selling Price

**Calculation:**

⇒ Discount = (2/17) × 17 = 2

⇒ Selling Price = Marked Price - Discount

⇒ Selling Price = 17 - 2 = 15

⇒ Ratio of Discount to Selling Price = Discount ÷ Selling Price

⇒ Ratio = 2 ÷ 15

⇒ Ratio = 2 : 15

**∴ The correct answer is 2 : 15.**

questions.question: P and Q working alone can complete a work in 5 days and 15 days respectively. They work on alternate days one at a time. P works on the first day. In how many days the whole work will be completed?
questions.solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

Total work (LCM of 5, 15) = 15 units.

Efficiency: **P** = 3 units/day, **Q** = 1 unit/day.

In a 2-day cycle (**P** + **Q**), work done = 3 + 1 = 4 units.

In 3 cycles (6 days), work done = 4 × 3 = 12 units.

Remaining 3 units (15 − 12) are completed by **P** on the **7th day** (3 ÷ 3 = 1 day).

**∴ The correct answer is 7 days.**

**__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Time taken by **P** = 5 days

Time taken by **Q** = 15 days

**Formula:** Efficiency = Total Work ÷ Time taken

 
 

 **Person**
 **Days**
 **Total Work (LCM)**
 **Efficiency**
 
 

 P
 5
 15
 3
 
 

 Q
 15
 1
 
 

⇒ Total work done in the first 2 days (P on day 1, Q on day 2) = 3 + 1 = 4 units

⇒ Work done in 6 days (3 cycles) = 4 × 3 = 12 units

⇒ Remaining work to be done after 6 days = 15 − 12 = 3 units

⇒ On the 7th day, it is **P**'s turn to work.

⇒ Time taken by **P** to finish remaining work = Remaining work ÷ Efficiency of P = 3 ÷ 3 = 1 day

⇒ Total days required = 6 + 1 = 7 days

**∴ The correct answer is 7 days.**

**__Additional Information__**

Alternate Day Work

In alternate work problems, calculate the work done in one full cycle (e.g., 2 days if there are 2 people) and then determine how many full cycles fit into the total work.

Total Work and Efficiency

Total Work = Time × Efficiency. Efficiency is the rate of work done per unit of time and is inversely proportional to the time taken.

Remaining Work Calculation

Time for remaining work = Remaining Work ÷ Efficiency of the person whose turn it is next. Always check who starts the work on the first day.</p
